title: Sri Lanka Highlights
description: The essentials of Sri Lanka in a week, at a relaxed pace with two nights at every stop: the Sigiriya rock fortress and wild elephants, sacred Kandy and its tea hills, and colonial Galle on the south coast.
signature: A home-cooked lunch with a farming family near Sigiriya
highlights: A home-cooked lunch with a farming family near Sigiriya
A dawn climb of Sigiriya rock fortress, before the heat and crowds
A jeep safari to watch wild elephants in Minneriya or Kaudulla
The evening ceremony at the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Sunset on the ramparts of Galle Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site

itinerary.title: Welcome to Sri Lanka
itinerary.description: Your chauffeur-guide meets you at Bandaranaike International Airport and takes you to your hotel in Negombo, just 20 minutes away. Rest after your flight, with a sunset walk along the beach.

itinerary.title: Into the Cultural Triangle
itinerary.description: Drive north through coconut groves and paddy fields to Sigiriya. On the way, stop at a village to share a home-cooked lunch with a farming family and see how rice is grown. Relax at your hotel surrounded by jungle.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya Rock and wild elephants
itinerary.description: Rise early to climb Sigiriya, the 5th-century rock fortress, before the heat and crowds arrive. Pass the painted frescoes and the giant lion's paws on the way to the summit. In the afternoon, take a jeep safari in Minneriya or Kaudulla National Park to watch herds of wild elephants.

itinerary.title: Dambulla and Kandy
itinerary.description: Visit the Dambulla cave temple, with its ancient Buddha statues and painted ceilings, then stop at a spice garden on the way to Kandy. In the evening, attend the ceremony at the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic.

itinerary.title: Gardens and tea hills
itinerary.description: Stroll through the Royal Botanical Gardens at Peradeniya, then visit a tea estate in the hills above Kandy to see how Ceylon tea is made, with a tasting. In the evening, watch a traditional Kandyan dance performance.

itinerary.title: Down to the south coast
itinerary.description: Travel south to the coast, stopping for a riverside lunch at Bentota, then continue to Galle. In the late afternoon, walk the ramparts of Galle Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and watch the sunset from the walls.

itinerary.title: Galle and the beach
itinerary.description: Explore the fort's lanes, lighthouse, old Dutch church and boutique cafés, then spend the afternoon on a nearby beach such as Unawatuna.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, your chauffeur-guide drives you to the airport for your flight home.

title: Classic Ceylon & Coast
description: The complete first visit at an easy pace: three nights among the ancient cities, sacred Kandy, two nights in tea country, the mountain village of Ella and three days on a palm-fringed beach to finish.
route: Negombo → Sigiriya → Kandy → Nuwara Eliya → Ella → Mirissa
signature: Village cycling and a home-cooked lunch with a farming family near Sigiriya
highlights: Village cycling and a home-cooked lunch with a farming family near Sigiriya
Cycling the medieval royal city of Polonnaruwa
A dawn walk to World's End in Horton Plains National Park
Little Adam's Peak and the Nine Arches Bridge in Ella
Optional whale watching from Mirissa with a responsible operator

itinerary.title: Welcome to Sri Lanka
itinerary.description: Your chauffeur-guide meets you at the airport and takes you to your hotel in Negombo, 20 minutes away. Rest after the flight and enjoy a sunset dinner by the sea.

itinerary.title: Into the Cultural Triangle
itinerary.description: Drive north through villages and paddy fields to Sigiriya, home to Sri Lanka's most famous ancient sites. Settle into your jungle hotel and spend the afternoon by the pool.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya Rock and village life
itinerary.description: Climb Sigiriya rock fortress at dawn, passing the frescoes and lion's paws on the way to the royal summit. Later, cycle through a nearby village, take a short ride on a traditional bullock cart or catamaran, and enjoy a home-cooked lunch with a local family.

itinerary.title: Polonnaruwa and elephant safari
itinerary.description: Explore the medieval royal city of Polonnaruwa by bicycle, with its palaces, temples and the great carved Buddhas of Gal Vihara. In the afternoon, head out on a jeep safari in Minneriya or Kaudulla to watch wild elephants gather by the water.

itinerary.title: Dambulla and Kandy
itinerary.description: Visit the Dambulla cave temple with its ancient statues and painted ceilings, then stop at a spice garden on the way to Kandy. In the evening, attend the ceremony at the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic.

itinerary.title: Kandy at leisure
itinerary.description: Stroll through the Royal Botanical Gardens at Peradeniya, famous for their orchids and avenues of giant palms. Walk around Kandy Lake and the town in the afternoon, and watch a traditional Kandyan dance performance in the evening.

itinerary.title: Into tea country
itinerary.description: Climb into the hills past waterfalls and tea estates to Nuwara Eliya. Stop at a working tea factory to see how Ceylon tea is made, with a tasting overlooking the plantations.

itinerary.title: Horton Plains
itinerary.description: Set off before dawn for Horton Plains National Park and walk the trail to World's End, where the land drops away nearly a kilometre to the plains below. Return to Nuwara Eliya for a relaxed afternoon by Gregory Lake.

itinerary.title: Through the hills to Ella
itinerary.description: A beautiful drive winds down through tea estates and mountain villages to Ella, with stops at viewpoints along the way. Spend the afternoon exploring the village's cafés and enjoying the valley views.

itinerary.title: Ella at leisure
itinerary.description: Walk up Little Adam's Peak in the cool of the morning for sweeping views of the hills. Later, visit the Nine Arches Bridge and Ravana Falls, or simply relax.

itinerary.title: Down to the coast
itinerary.description: Leave the hills and drive south to Mirissa, a laid-back beach town lined with palms. Spend the afternoon on the sand.

itinerary.title: Whale watching
itinerary.description: Join an early-morning boat trip with a responsible operator in search of blue whales and dolphins (optional). Spend the rest of the day on the beach or at Coconut Tree Hill.

itinerary.title: Galle Fort
itinerary.description: Take a short trip along the coast to Galle Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Walk the ramparts, see the lighthouse and browse the boutiques, then return to Mirissa for a final sunset.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, your chauffeur-guide drives you to the airport for your flight home.

title: Untamed Sri Lanka: Cloud Forests, Leopards & Whales
description: Three national parks, the cloud forest of Horton Plains and the ocean: a journey built around Sri Lanka's wildlife, always watched responsibly, and with two nights at almost every stop.
route: Wilpattu → Sigiriya → Kandy → Nuwara Eliya → Yala → Mirissa
signature: A full-day private safari in Wilpattu with a naturalist tracker, far from the crowds
highlights: A full-day private safari in Wilpattu with a naturalist tracker, far from the crowds
Wild elephants grazing by the reservoirs of Minneriya or Kaudulla
The cloud forest of Horton Plains and the cliffs of World's End
A day on safari in Yala, home to one of the highest densities of leopards in the world
Whale watching off Mirissa with a responsible operator

itinerary.title: Arrive and head for Wilpattu
itinerary.description: Your chauffeur-guide meets you at the airport and drives you north to a lodge on the edge of Wilpattu, Sri Lanka's largest national park. Unwind to the sounds of the forest.

itinerary.title: Wilpattu safari
itinerary.description: Spend the day on safari in Wilpattu, a quiet park of natural lakes and dense forest, with a naturalist tracker. Search for leopards, sloth bears, spotted deer and a rich variety of birds, with far fewer jeeps than the better-known parks.

itinerary.title: To Sigiriya and the elephant gathering
itinerary.description: Drive east to Sigiriya. In the afternoon, take a jeep safari in Minneriya or Kaudulla, where wild elephants come to graze and bathe by the reservoirs.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya Rock and birdlife
itinerary.description: Climb Sigiriya rock fortress at dawn, when the light is soft and the birds are active. Later, take a guided nature walk in the surrounding forest and villages.

itinerary.title: Kandy
itinerary.description: Drive to Kandy, Sri Lanka's hill capital. Visit the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic for the evening ceremony and walk around Kandy Lake.

itinerary.title: Into the highlands
itinerary.description: Climb into the hills past waterfalls and tea estates to Nuwara Eliya. In the afternoon, look for the hill country's endemic birds in Victoria Park.

itinerary.title: Horton Plains cloud forest
itinerary.description: Set off before dawn for Horton Plains National Park, a high plateau of grassland and cloud forest. Walk to World's End, where the cliff drops away nearly a kilometre, looking for sambar deer and endemic birds along the trail.

itinerary.title: To Yala
itinerary.description: Drive down from the hills through Ella and Wellawaya, stopping at Ravana Falls and the ancient Buduruwagala rock carvings, to the dry south-east, where the forest gives way to scrub and lagoons. Arrive at your lodge near Yala in time for sunset.

itinerary.title: Yala safari
itinerary.description: Spend the day on safari in Yala National Park, home to one of the highest densities of leopards in the world. Look out for elephants, crocodiles, sloth bears and hundreds of bird species.

itinerary.title: To the coast
itinerary.description: After an optional early safari, drive west to the beach at Mirissa and spend the afternoon on the sand.

itinerary.title: Whale watching
itinerary.description: Head out early with a responsible operator in search of blue whales, sperm whales and spinner dolphins. Spend the afternoon on the beach.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, your chauffeur-guide drives you to the airport for your flight home.

title: Summer Family Adventure
description: Temples, tea hills, wild elephants, surf lessons and calm east-coast beaches, timed for the UK school holidays when Sri Lanka's east coast is at its best. Short drives and plenty of downtime keep everyone happy.
route: Negombo → Kandy → Nuwara Eliya → Ella → Arugam Bay → Pasikuda → Sigiriya → Negombo
signature: A hands-on family cooking class, a bullock-cart ride and a pottery session for the children in a Sigiriya village
highlights: A hands-on family cooking class, a bullock-cart ride and a pottery session for the children in a Sigiriya village
A Kandyan dance show with fire-walkers
The Nine Arches Bridge and an easy family walk up Little Adam's Peak
A beginner surf lesson or a jeep safari at Arugam Bay
Calm, shallow water for young swimmers at Pasikuda

itinerary.title: Welcome to Sri Lanka
itinerary.description: Your chauffeur-guide meets the family at the airport and takes you to your beachside hotel in Negombo, just 20 minutes away. Swim, rest and settle in.

itinerary.title: To Kandy
itinerary.description: Drive into the hills to Kandy, the island's last royal capital. In the evening, visit the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic and watch the drummers during the evening ceremony.

itinerary.title: Gardens and dancers
itinerary.description: Explore the Royal Botanical Gardens at Peradeniya, where children love the giant bamboo, the fruit bats and the huge lawns. In the evening, enjoy a lively Kandyan dance show with fire-walkers.

itinerary.title: Waterfalls and tea
itinerary.description: Climb into tea country, stopping at waterfalls and a tea factory where the children can see how tea leaves become the tea in your cup. Arrive in cool Nuwara Eliya and take a boat ride on Gregory Lake.

itinerary.title: Down to Ella
itinerary.description: A scenic drive through tea estates and mountain villages brings you to Ella. Stop at Ravana Falls on the way, then relax in the village.

itinerary.title: Ella adventures
itinerary.description: Visit the Nine Arches Bridge and take an easy family walk up Little Adam's Peak for wonderful views. Older children may enjoy the zipline in Ella.

itinerary.title: To the east coast
itinerary.description: Drive down from the hills to Arugam Bay, a friendly surf town on the east coast. Spend the afternoon on the beach.

itinerary.title: Surf or safari
itinerary.description: Take a beginner surf lesson on a gentle wave, or join a jeep safari in Kumana or Lahugala to look for elephants, crocodiles and birdlife.

itinerary.title: To Pasikuda
itinerary.description: Drive up the coast to Pasikuda, with its long, shallow bay of calm, clear water, ideal for young swimmers.

itinerary.title: Beach day
itinerary.description: A free day to swim, build sandcastles and snorkel in the calm bay.

itinerary.title: Boat trip or free day
itinerary.description: Take an optional boat trip along the coast, or visit the old Dutch fort and lagoon at Batticaloa.

itinerary.title: To Sigiriya and the elephants
itinerary.description: Drive inland to Sigiriya. In the afternoon, take a jeep safari in Kaudulla or Minneriya, where August is the peak of the great elephant gathering.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya Rock and village life
itinerary.description: Climb Sigiriya rock fortress early in the morning. Later, cycle through a village, ride a bullock cart and help cook a traditional Sri Lankan lunch.

itinerary.title: Back to the coast
itinerary.description: After a slow breakfast, drive back towards the west coast, stopping for lunch on the way. Spend a last relaxed evening on the beach in Negombo.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, your chauffeur-guide takes you to the airport, just 20 minutes away, for your flight home.

title: Footprints in the Hills & Northern Frontiers
description: Go beyond the classic route: the ancient city of Anuradhapura, the Tamil culture of Jaffna and Trincomalee's beaches, then the Cultural Triangle and Kandy, finishing with three slow nights walking the Pekoe Trail from a planter's bungalow.
route: Negombo → Anuradhapura → Jaffna → Trincomalee → Sigiriya → Kandy → Hatton
signature: A Jaffna Tamil cooking session and lunch with a local family
highlights: A Jaffna Tamil cooking session and lunch with a local family
The great white dagobas and sacred Bo tree of Anuradhapura at sunset
A boat to Nainativu and the islands off Jaffna
Snorkelling among coral and reef fish at Pigeon Island
Three slow nights walking the Pekoe Trail from a planter's bungalow

itinerary.title: Welcome to Sri Lanka
itinerary.description: Your chauffeur-guide meets you at the airport and takes you to your hotel in Negombo, 20 minutes away. Rest after the flight.

itinerary.title: Anuradhapura
itinerary.description: Drive north to Anuradhapura, Sri Lanka's first great capital. In the late afternoon, visit the vast white dagobas and the sacred Bo tree as pilgrims gather at sunset.

itinerary.title: North to Jaffna
itinerary.description: After a morning among the ancient ruins, travel north on the A9 across the dry plains and over the causeway into Jaffna, the heart of Sri Lanka's Tamil culture.

itinerary.title: Discovering Jaffna
itinerary.description: Visit the golden Nallur Kandaswamy Kovil, the Dutch-built Jaffna Fort and the busy market. Join a local family to cook and share a Jaffna-style lunch, quite different from the food of the south.

itinerary.title: The islands
itinerary.description: Cross the causeways to the islands off Jaffna and take a short boat to Nainativu, home to both a Hindu and a Buddhist temple. Finish at Casuarina Beach.

itinerary.title: Down the coast to Trincomalee
itinerary.description: Drive south along the quiet north-east coast, stopping for lunch and a walk on the beach at Mullaitivu to break the journey. Arrive in Trincomalee, with its deep natural harbour and white-sand beaches.

itinerary.title: Pigeon Island and Koneswaram
itinerary.description: Snorkel among coral and reef fish at Pigeon Island National Park. Later, visit Koneswaram Temple on its cliff above the sea.

itinerary.title: To Sigiriya and the elephants
itinerary.description: Drive inland to Sigiriya. In the afternoon, take a jeep safari in Kaudulla or Minneriya to watch wild elephants by the water.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya and Polonnaruwa
itinerary.description: Climb Sigiriya rock fortress at dawn, then explore the medieval city of Polonnaruwa by bicycle, including the great carved Buddhas of Gal Vihara.

itinerary.title: Dambulla and Kandy
itinerary.description: Visit the Dambulla cave temple on the way to Kandy. In the evening, attend the ceremony at the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic.

itinerary.title: Kandy at leisure
itinerary.description: Stroll through the Royal Botanical Gardens at Peradeniya, walk around Kandy Lake, and watch a Kandyan dance performance in the evening.

itinerary.title: A planter's bungalow
itinerary.description: Drive into the tea hills to a colonial-era planter's bungalow near Hatton, with high tea on the lawn and views over the estates.

itinerary.title: Walking the Pekoe Trail
itinerary.description: Walk a guided stage of the Pekoe Trail through tea estates, villages and forest, with views over the Castlereagh reservoir.

itinerary.title: Adam's Peak or a slow day
itinerary.description: In pilgrimage season (December to May), make the optional night climb of Adam's Peak for sunrise. Otherwise, enjoy a slow day on the estate with a tea factory visit.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, your chauffeur-guide drives you to the airport for your flight home.

itinerary.title: Life on the estate
itinerary.description: Walk among the tea bushes with a local guide, try plucking tea and enjoy a tasting. Later, have a private picnic beside the lake or simply relax in the bungalow.

itinerary.title: Through the hills to Ella
itinerary.description: Drive through the hill country past Nuwara Eliya, stopping for high tea at a colonial hotel. Arrive in Ella in time for sunset over the valley.

itinerary.title: To the beach
itinerary.description: Visit the Nine Arches Bridge in the morning, then drive down to the south coast and your secluded beach villa near Tangalle.

itinerary.title: Beach and spa
itinerary.description: A lazy day on the sand, with a couple's spa treatment in the afternoon.

itinerary.title: Turtles and sunset
itinerary.description: A free day to relax. In the evening, you can join a guided turtle-watching visit at Rekawa beach to see sea turtles come ashore.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, your chauffeur-guide drives you to the airport for your flight home.

itinerary.title: To tea country

itinerary.title: Estate walks and yoga

itinerary.title: To your Ayurveda resort

itinerary.title: To Kandy
itinerary.description: Drive into the hills to Kandy. In the evening, attend the ceremony at the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic.

itinerary.title: First steps on the Pekoe Trail
itinerary.description: Walk the opening stage of the Pekoe Trail near Kandy with your walking guide, through villages, spice gardens and the first tea estates.

itinerary.title: To the tea bungalow
itinerary.description: Drive to a colonial planter's bungalow near Hatton. In the afternoon, take a short walk around the estate.

itinerary.title: Reservoir and tea country walk
itinerary.description: Walk a stage of the Pekoe Trail around the Castlereagh and Norton reservoirs, with wide views across tea country. Return to the bungalow for high tea.

itinerary.title: Adam's Peak or a rest day
itinerary.description: In pilgrimage season (December to May), make the optional night climb of Adam's Peak to watch the sunrise from the summit. Otherwise, enjoy a rest day at the bungalow.

itinerary.title: Through the hills to Ella
itinerary.description: Drive through tea country past Nuwara Eliya to Ella, stopping at viewpoints and a tea factory on the way.

itinerary.title: Walking around Ella
itinerary.description: Walk a Pekoe Trail stage near Ella, taking in the Nine Arches Bridge and Little Adam's Peak.

itinerary.title: To Galle
itinerary.description: Drive down to the south coast, stopping at Udawalawe to watch the midday feeding at the Elephant Transit Home, then spend the evening walking the ramparts of Galle Fort at sunset.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, your chauffeur-guide drives you to the airport for your flight home.

inclusions: Private air-conditioned vehicle (car, van or coach, depending on group size) with an English-speaking guide for the whole trip
All hotels as listed (or similar), with breakfast daily; standard check-in is 12:00
Meals and experiences named in the itinerary
Jeep safaris and boat trips named in the itinerary
Airport meet-and-greet, all transfers, and 1 litre of bottled water per person per day
A UK-based contact before you travel
optional: Swap the day 7 drive for the scenic hill-country train to Ella, subject to seat availability.
note: Your walking guide chooses Pekoe Trail stages to suit your fitness; most stages take 4 to 6 hours on foot.

title: Grand Explorer
description: The complete island journey: the ancient cities of Anuradhapura and Polonnaruwa, Sigiriya, Kandy, a tea planter's bungalow, Ella, leopards in Yala and the colonial charm of Galle, all at a comfortable pace.
targetAudience: Travellers who want to see it all
route: Negombo → Anuradhapura → Sigiriya → Kandy → Hatton → Ella → Yala → Galle
signature: An early-morning private Yala safari with a specialist leopard tracker
highlights: An early-morning private Yala safari with a specialist leopard tracker
Anuradhapura at sunset and the steps of Mihintale
Cycling Polonnaruwa, then an elephant safari
Two nights in a tea planter's bungalow
Sunset on the ramparts of Galle Fort

itinerary.title: Welcome to Sri Lanka
itinerary.description: Your chauffeur-guide meets you at the airport and takes you to your hotel in Negombo, 20 minutes away. Rest after the flight.

itinerary.title: Anuradhapura
itinerary.description: Drive north to Anuradhapura, Sri Lanka's first great capital. In the late afternoon, visit the vast white dagobas and the sacred Bo tree as pilgrims gather at sunset.

itinerary.title: Mihintale and Sigiriya
itinerary.description: Climb the steps of Mihintale, where Buddhism is said to have arrived in Sri Lanka, then continue to Sigiriya.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya Rock and village life
itinerary.description: Climb Sigiriya rock fortress at dawn. Later, cycle through a nearby village and share a home-cooked lunch with a local family.

itinerary.title: Polonnaruwa and elephant safari
itinerary.description: Explore the medieval royal city of Polonnaruwa by bicycle, then take an afternoon jeep safari in Minneriya or Kaudulla to watch wild elephants.

itinerary.title: Dambulla and Kandy
itinerary.description: Visit the Dambulla cave temple and a spice garden on the way to Kandy. In the evening, attend the ceremony at the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic.

itinerary.title: Kandy at leisure
itinerary.description: Stroll through the Royal Botanical Gardens at Peradeniya, walk around Kandy Lake, and watch a Kandyan dance performance in the evening.

itinerary.title: A planter's bungalow
itinerary.description: Drive into the tea hills to a colonial planter's bungalow near Hatton, with high tea on the lawn.

itinerary.title: Life on the tea estate
itinerary.description: Walk through the tea gardens with a local guide, visit a tea factory and enjoy a tasting overlooking the estates.

itinerary.title: Through the hills to Ella
itinerary.description: Drive through tea country past Nuwara Eliya to Ella, stopping at viewpoints and waterfalls along the way.

itinerary.title: Ella at leisure
itinerary.description: Walk up Little Adam's Peak in the morning, then visit the Nine Arches Bridge and Ravana Falls.

itinerary.title: To Yala
itinerary.description: Drive down to the dry south-east and your lodge near Yala. In the afternoon, head out on your first safari.

itinerary.title: Yala safari
itinerary.description: An early-morning safari in Yala National Park, the best time to look for leopards, elephants and sloth bears. Relax at the lodge in the afternoon.

itinerary.title: To Galle
itinerary.description: Drive west along the coast to Galle. Walk the ramparts of Galle Fort at sunset.

itinerary.title: Galle and the beach
itinerary.description: Browse the boutiques and cafés inside the fort, relax on a nearby beach, or join an optional whale-watching trip from Mirissa.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, your chauffeur-guide drives you to the airport for your flight home.
